name: worker-fleet
description: Supervisor-side loops that run development through Claude worker sessions. issue-ready-prep is the human-present step: before an issue reaches Ready it fills in what request-create will ask — work type, goal, background, acceptance criteria, slug, and the base branch — and writes them into the issue as a machine-readable block, which raises Ready from "someone may start this" to "this can be started unattended". issue-to-review-ready then runs unattended: it takes one prepared Ready issue, moves it to In progress before touching anything, answers request-create from the prepared values rather than guessing, stands up a worker in its own worktree, confirms the draft PR exists rather than trusting the report, hands the review to codex-draft-review, verifies the undraft and reviewer assignment, advances the board, and moves to the next issue — and if it stops anywhere, it puts the status back, because an issue parked in In progress is worse than an untouched one. worker-fleet-loop adds the parallel case: one tick sweeps every worker, answering approvals (everything except merge), nudging the silent, and dispatching one new lane into capacity measured fresh each tick. The implementation belongs to openspec-workflow and the review to pr-loop; this plugin owns the lane.
